presentationTable.name: Date

presentationColumns.name: Calendar Date
presentationColumns.description: Calendar day represented by the fact row or analysis context. Use it for daily filtering and time-series detail.

presentationColumns.name: Day Of Week
presentationColumns.description: Name of the day in the week, useful for comparing weekday and weekend retail behavior.

presentationColumns.name: Week Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Start date of the retail analysis week. Use it for weekly sales, inventory, and AI signal trend analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Month Number
presentationColumns.description: Calendar month number from 1 to 12, useful for sorting month-based views.

presentationColumns.name: Month Name
presentationColumns.description: Calendar month name for readable monthly reporting.

presentationColumns.name: Quarter Number
presentationColumns.description: Calendar quarter number, useful for quarterly trend and seasonal comparisons.

presentationColumns.name: Calendar Year
presentationColumns.description: Calendar year associated with the date.

presentationColumns.name: Fiscal Year
presentationColumns.description: Fiscal year associated with the date, aligned to the FashionDW fiscal calendar.

presentationColumns.name: Fiscal Period
presentationColumns.description: Fiscal accounting period associated with the date.

presentationColumns.name: Is Weekend
presentationColumns.description: Flags Saturday and Sunday dates. Use it to compare weekend and weekday shopping patterns.

presentationColumns.name: Is Holiday Peak
presentationColumns.description: Flags dates in high-traffic holiday or peak selling periods.

presentationTable.description: Core calendar dimension used by sales, inventory, movement, traffic, marts, and AI signal facts.
